transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I guess I’ve just been feeling really worn out most days. Even when I sleep through the night, I get up for my cashier shift and my body and my head still feel… heavy, like I’m dragging.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t really call it depressed. Maybe just tired and kind of worn down.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about things, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?

Yeah… I guess I do. My mind just kind of jumps around a lot—money stuff, the relative staying with us, my wife being stressed… church things. And then I start thinking maybe I’m messing up at work too. It’s just… a lot of little things.
When you wake up in the morning, do you usually feel rested?
Not really. I mean, I go to bed tired, but then I’m just lying there thinking about bills, work, home stuff… and even if I sleep, I wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Have you been feeling sad or low most days?
Not most days, no. I mean… I get worn out, but I wouldn’t really say sad all the time.
Do you find it hard to control the worrying once it starts?

Yeah… it can be hard. I’ll try to tell myself to just pray on it or leave it alone, but then it keeps going. One worry turns into the next, and pretty soon I’m thinking through all the ways the day could go bad.
Would you say you worry more than most people do?
Probably, yeah. I mean… my mind just keeps jumping around—money, stuff at home, my wife being stressed, church things, work… whether I’m messing something up. It feels like more than it should be.
Do you often feel physically tense, like your muscles are tight?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to that. Maybe sometimes, but I’m not sure.
Have you been worrying like this on most days for at least six months?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been maybe a year and a few months now—since our older relative moved in with us.
Do you often have trouble concentrating because your mind is busy with worry?
Yeah… sometimes. At the register I’ll be staring right at the screen and still kind of lose my place, thinking about home or bills. Then I have to recount the drawer or catch some little mistake.
Have you been feeling more irritable than usual?
I’m not really sure. Maybe a little sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being a big change.
Do you feel tired easily most days?
Yeah… most days, I guess. I wake up after sleeping and still feel worn out, like my body and my head are dragging before I even get to my cashier shift.
Do you often feel physically tense, like your muscles are tight?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid much attention to that. Maybe a little here and there, but I’m not sure.
Over the past year, have you felt down or depressed most days?
I don’t think so… not most days. I mean, I’ve had off days, but I wouldn’t really call it depressed.
Do you often have trouble falling asleep?

Yeah… a lot of nights. I’ll be tired, but once I’m in bed my mind starts going over bills and work stuff, and whether things at home are okay. Then even if I sleep, it doesn’t really feel like I settled down.

latest_inference.note: Sustained excessive, hard-to-control worry across multiple domains for >6 months with fatigue, poor concentration, and sleep disturbance strongly supports F41.1. Repeated denial of depressed mood most days makes F32.9, F33.9, and F34.1 less likely and they are removed. Persistent nonrestorative sleep keeps F51.1 as a differential; F48.0 remains a weaker fatigue-related alternative.
